Layout report for Poster template (build 2026-10-09)
page: A0 portrait (841 x 1189 mm)
base text size chosen by autofit: 28.0 pt (range 28-46)
header title size: 130 pt
theme: neutral (Neutral slate), state ready
  colours from: Tailwind CSS default palette (slate, blue, amber) https://tailwindcss.com/docs/colors (licence MIT)
  typeface: DejaVu Sans Condensed
  contrast: 26 pairings checked, 0 below the recommended level, lowest 6.41 (links on card)
body height: 885 mm available, 878 mm natural, slack 6 mm

Blocks (why each one looks the way it does):
- intro: 222 mm wide, 176 mm natural, 196 mm drawn
    why: Text part from a Markdown file; shows the supported Markdown subset.
- numbers: 182 mm wide, 146 mm natural, 196 mm drawn
    why: Two parts in one card: a short inline text and large numbers, which read from two metres away.
- howto: 202 mm wide, 196 mm natural, 196 mm drawn
    why: Shows sub-headings in a text file and the accent override.
- photo: 162 mm wide, 176 mm natural, 196 mm drawn
    why: The gallery part: pictures in a grid with captions; cover crops to fill, a missing file is a dashed box.
- pipeline: 801 mm wide, 193 mm natural, 193 mm drawn
    why: A flow beats prose for sequences. per_row wraps long chains with elbow arrows; status is never colour alone.
- mapping: 334 mm wide, 168 mm natural, 193 mm drawn
    why: Tables show mappings and comparisons that prose hides.
- figure: 247 mm wide, 183 mm natural, 193 mm drawn
    why: An SVG figure stays vector; the caption sits underneath. max_height_mm caps tall images.
- team: 198 mm wide, 187 mm natural, 193 mm drawn
    why: The people module: cropped photos, names, optional role, no institution. A missing photo shows initials.
- outlook: 236 mm wide, 151 mm natural, 163 mm drawn
    why: A timeline for dated steps; status styles come from the theme.
- links: 236 mm wide, 163 mm natural, 163 mm drawn
    why: QR codes in one row, label underneath; partner logos as a second part.
- supporters: 307 mm wide, 160 mm natural, 163 mm drawn
    why: The supporters module: labelled groups of logos. Without a logo file, the name is drawn in a box.
- references: 527 mm wide, 74 mm natural, 96 mm drawn
    why: Small type is fine here; references are for the follow-up reader.
- quote: 263 mm wide, 96 mm natural, 96 mm drawn
    why: An unframed block keeps one sentence from disappearing among the cards.
